A '''buffer''' was a cleaning tool. [[MN-2E general maintenance droid]]s were equipped with a buffer located at the end of one of their [[Manipulator arm/Legends|manipulator arms]].<ref name="EGTD" /> During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Vette]] wanted to acquire a [[Lekku/Legends|lekku]] buffer in the [[Corellian Sector (Nar Shaddaa)/Legends|Corellian Sector]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="TOR" />
